details.description: Kimi K2.7 Code is Moonshot AI's coding-focused agentic model, built on the Kimi K2.6 architecture as a 1-trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 32 billion activated parameters and a 256K-token context window. It is tuned for real-world, long-horizon software engineering tasks, follows instructions more reliably over long contexts, and supports image and video input alongside interleaved thinking and multi-step tool calling, with thinking mode on by default.
advantages: Moonshot AI reports it reduces thinking-token usage by about 30% compared to its Kimi K2.6 predecessor while improving on long-horizon coding tasks.
Scores 62.0 on Kimi Code Bench v2 and 81.1 on MCP Mark Verified, per Moonshot AI's model card.
Supports image and video input in addition to text, per Moonshot AI's model card.
disadvantages: Forces thinking mode on by default, which Moonshot AI's own documentation notes as a behavioral difference from other Kimi models.
use_cases: Long-horizon software engineering and coding agent workflows
Multi-step tool calling within coding tasks
Following detailed instructions reliably across long contexts

notes: Left evaluations empty: the benchmark table on the model card (Kimi Code Bench v2, Program Bench, MLS Bench Lite, Kimi Claw 24/7 Bench, MCP Atlas, MCP Mark Verified) uses Moonshot AI's own named coding/agent benchmarks rather than widely recognized public leaderboards, so two of the clearest figures were instead cited as advantages with attribution; the full table is on the same card if the team wants it included as evaluations. Catalog facts list max_input_tokens/max_output_tokens at 262144, matching the maker's stated 256K context window.
